responsibility: Synthesizes aggregate special-member functions and merges their inferred attributes. This file decides when structs need generated identity `opAssign`, field destructors, aggregate destructors, postblits, and inclusive invariants; constructs the corresponding AST bodies from field-wise operations or swaps and chained calls; and computes the combined purity, safety, nothrow, nogc, and disable attributes for those generated functions from the members they invoke.
